Rule.Name: Microsoft_Direct3D_DXC
Rule.Description: Options for the Microsoft.Direct3D.DXC NuGet package

StringProperty.Name: Microsoft_Direct3D_DXC_CopyLocation
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the executable-relative destination for the DXC runtime files.

BoolProperty.Name: Microsoft_Direct3D_DXC_SkipLibraryCopy
BoolProperty.Description: Disables copying the DXC runtime files into the project output directory.

BoolProperty.Name: Microsoft_Direct3D_DXC_SkipIncludeDir
BoolProperty.Description: Disables adding the package include directory to the compiler search path.
